entries.title: A site in a task's browser can ask you for your camera, notifications or clipboard
entries.body: When you have control of a task's browser and the site asks to use your camera or microphone, send you notifications or read your clipboard, a row above the page asks you, with Allow once and Not now. What you allow lasts until you return control, so the crewmate never uses a page with your camera on. When the site asks for a passkey, the browser tells it none is available, so it offers a password or a code, and a line above the page tells you why.

picture.alt: A task's browser under your control, with a row above the page saying the site asks to send you notifications, and Allow once and Not now buttons
